_comment: The crew roster. D owns this file and the art; C owns the loader in Sources/main.swift.
Adding a crew member is a row here plus a .mov in Assets/ — no Swift edit.
role     — must match the `character` field the orchestrator POSTs to :4002.
asset    — Assets/<asset>.mov, transparent HEVC, portrait. No extension here.
mirrored — flip horizontally. Only needed while two roles share one clip.
activities{}: playback rate while `working`, keyed on the POST's `activity`
rather than on the role — so two agents doing research move alike and this
file never has to learn the roster. 1.0 is the clip's natural speed.
Omit an activity and it falls back to the plain `working` tempo (1.15).
If this file is missing or unparseable the dock uses the built-in three and
logs it, so the rehearsed run can never be broken by a bad edit here.

PLACEHOLDER (A, stopgap): researcher and analyst reuse the two upstream clips so a longer task visibly drops more characters TODAY. D — these two rows are yours the moment you have art; swap `asset` and drop `mirrored`. Nothing else needs to change.
D: recap now has its OWN clip (walk-recap-01) — it is no longer triage flipped.
researcher and analyst are still on A's placeholders and remain my gap.
